title: Uncover Hidden Insights
description: In group discussions: - Encourage: Ask each member to share unique perspectives or information. - Facilitate: Guide the conversation to ensure unshared insights are discussed. - Balance: Avoid spending too much time on what everyone already knows. Example: Start meetings by asking, "What does everyone know that hasn’t been shared yet?"
